name: Mark of the Authority
body:
Price 7,450 gp; Slot neck; CL 6th; Weight ½ lb.; Aura moderate enchantment

DESCRIPTION

This brass badge is emblazoned with the motif of a hawk and an olive branch in front of a star. This mark grants the wearer and all allies within 30 feet a +1 competence bonus on combat maneuver checks and to CMD. In addition, the wearer may cast each of the following spells once per day: bungle (DC 15), memorize page, and unprepared combatant (DC 15).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,725 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells bungle, heroism, memorize page, and unprepared combatant
